senses.gloss:
भिन्दत्, अन्, अती, अत्, breaking, splitting, cleaving,
piercing, destroying, dividing.

भिन्दु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. breaking, splitting; de-
stroying; a destroyer; (उस्), m. a drop [cf. बिन्दू];
(उस्), f. a woman bringing forth a still-born child, a
woman who bears a dead child; [cf. निन्दु.]
भिन्दु भिन्दु, भिन्न, &c. See p. 710, col. 3.

भिन्द्धि-लवणा, f. (fr. 2nd sing. Impv.), con-
stant sprinkling of salt; [cf. पच-ल्˚.]

भिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, broken, fractured, split,
(भिन्ना नौः, a leaky ship, a wrecked vessel);
torn, rent, cloven, pounded, lacerated; opened, ex-
panded, budded, blossoming; divided, separated
into parts, anything less than a whole; detached,
disunited, disjoined; loosened; separated or different
from; distinct, other, different (e. g. आङ्-भिन्नो-
निपातः, any particle other than आङ्); deviated,
deviating or varying from; deprived of, without;
furious (as an elephant, see भिन्न-करट); mingled,
mixed, cleaving to; (अस्), m. a flaw or defect in a
jewel; (अम्), n. a fragment, bit, part, portion; (in
arithmetic) a fraction; a blossom; a wound from a
pointed weapon, a stab; a particular mode of fight-
ing mentioned in Hari-vaṃśa 15978 (also read
मित्र.)
—भिन्न-करट, अस्, m. an elephant in
rut or from whose divided temples the juice exudes.
—भिन्न-कर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, having divided ears
(said of particular animals).
—भिन्न-कूट, अस्, आ,
अम्, deprived of a chief or leader (said of an army).
—भिन्न-क्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, having the order
broken, out of order or place, displaced.
—भिन्न-
गति, इस्, इस्, इ, going with great strides, going quickly.
—भिन्न-गर्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, disunited in its
centre (said of an army), broken up, disorganized.
—भिन्न-गात्रिका, f. a kind of cucumber, Cucumis
Usitatissimus (= कर्कटी).
—भिन्न-गुणन, अम्,
n. multiplication of fractions.
—भिन्न-घन, अस्,
m. the cube of a fraction.
—भिन्न-जातीय, अस्, आ,
अम्, of a different tribe or caste.
—भिन्न-त्व, अम्,
n. the state of being different, difference, variation.
—भिन्न-दर्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or भिन्न-दृश्, क्,
क्, क्, seeing different things, seeing a difference,
making a difference, partial, (opposed to सम-
दर्शिन्.)
—भिन्न-देश, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to
different or various places; occurring or happening
in various places.
—भिन्नदेश-त्व, अम्, n. the
condition of being widely distant.
—भिन्न-देह,
अस्, आ, अम्, ‘whose body is pierced,’ wounded.
—भिन्न-नौ, औस्, औस्, उ, or भिन्न-नौक,
अस्, आ, अम्, ‘whose ship is broken,’ shipwrecked.
—भिन्न-परिकर्मन्, अ, n. an arithmetical ope-
ration with fractions.
—भिन्न-प्रकार, अस्, आ,
अम्, of a different kind or sort.
—भिन्न-भाग-
हर, अस्, m. division of fractions.
—भिन्न-भाण्ड
or भिन्न-भाजन, अम्, n. a broken pot or vessel,
potsherd.
—भिन्न-भिन्नात्मन् (˚न-आत्˚), आ, m.
chick-pea, Cicer Arietinum.
—भिन्न-मर्मन्, आ,
आ, अ, pierced in the vital organs, mortally wounded.
—भिन्न-मर्याद, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘whose course is
broken or separated from the right way,’ uncontrolled,
unrestrained; unbounded.
—भिन्न-मस्तक-पिण्-
डक or -पिण्डिक, अस्, आ, अम्, whose skull and
forehead is cloven, (an elephant) whose frontal globes
are open.
—भिन्न-योजनी, f. the plant Plectran-
thus Scutellarioides (= पाषाण-भेद).
—भिन्न-
लिङ्ग, अम्, n. incongruity of gender in a comparison.
—भिन्न-वचन, अम्, n. incongruity of number
in a comparison.
—भिन्न-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who
has divided.
—भिन्न-वर्ग, अस्, m. the square of a
fraction.
—भिन्न-वर्चस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or भिन्न-
वर्चस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, voiding excrement, &c.
—भिन्-
वर्चस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, changed in colour, discoloured,
pale; of a different caste or tribe.
—भिन्न-वर्त्-
मन्, आ, आ, अ, separated from the right way; [cf.
भिन्न-मर्याद.]
—भिन्न-विट्क, अस्, आ, अम् (fr.
भिन्न + विष्), = भिन्न-वर्चस्.
—भिन्नविट्क-
त्व, अम्, n. the state of one who voids excrement,
&c., (according to some commentators) change of
colour in the feces.
—भिन्न-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
having abandoned the path of duty, leading a bad
life; containing a metrical fault.
—भिन्न-वृत्ति,
[]
इस्, इस्, इ, having different occupations, occupied dif-
ferently; leading a bad life; neglecting prescribed
observances, following bad courses.
—भिन्नवृत्ति-
ता, f. the following of evil courses, neglect of pre-
scribed observances.
—भिन्न-व्यवकलित, अम्, n.
subtraction of fractions.
—भिन्न-संहति, इस्, इस्, इ,
whose union is broken, disunited.
—भिन्न-सङ्-
कलन or भिन्न-सङ्कलित, अम्, n. addition of
fractions.
—भिन्न-स्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, having a
broken or changed voice, hesitating in speech, fal-
tering; discordant.
—भिन्नस्वर-मुख-वर्ण,
अस्, आ, अम्, having a broken or changed voice and
complexion.
—भिन्न-हृदय, अस्, आ, अम्, pierced
through the heart.
—भिन्नाञ्जन (˚न-अञ्˚), अम्,
n. divided antimony, pounded collyrium, or colly-
rium mixed (with oil and used as an eye-salve), eye-
ointment consisting of various materials pounded and
mixed.
—भिन्नाञ्जद्न-चयोपम (˚य-उप्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, like a quantity of pounded antimony or
mixed collyrium.
—भिन्नाञ्जन-सन्निभ, अस्, आ,
अम्, similar to pounded antimony or mixed pigment.
—भिन्नाञ्जनाकर (˚न-आक्˚), or भिन्नाञ्जना-
भ (˚न-आभ˚), अस्, आ, अम्, appearing like pounded
antimony or mixed collyrium.
—भिन्नाभिन्न
(˚न-अभ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, distinct and not distinct,
separate and not separate.
—भिन्नार्थ (˚न-अर्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, having a clear or distinct meaning, clear,
evident, intelligible, perspicuous.
—भिन्नार्थ-ता,
f. clearness of meaning, intelligibleness, clearness.
—भिन्नोदर (˚न-उद्˚), अस्, m. a brother by a
different mother, a half brother.

भिन्नक, अस्, m. ‘a seceder,’ a Buddhist; N. of
a musical mode or Rāga.

भिन्द् भिन्द्, a various reading for rt.
बिन्द्, q. v.

भिन्दपाल भिन्दपाल or भिन्दिपाल, अस्, m.
a short javelin or arrow thrown from the hand or shot
through a tube; a stone fastened to a string; (also
read भिन्दमाल, भिन्दुमाल, भिण्डिमाल, भिण्-
डिमाला.)
